reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner-operator comparing automation to hiring or manual work, adhering strictly to Bareni's calm voice, boundaries, and no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The core point and structure are immediately clear, unpacking the abstract topic into a coherent operational diagnosis with plain, unambiguous language.
reasons.actionability: Provides a highly concrete, scoped diagnostic exercise (counting pauses over one week) to help the owner decide if the workflow warrants automation, while keeping human approval central.
reasons.factual_grounding: Contains no invented customers, deployments, or fabricated performance claims; frames capabilities conservatively and preserves human oversight boundaries.
